protocolPolicy.allowedHint: Choose which chat requests may use this channel. Dedicated image and audio endpoints are unaffected.
protocolPolicy.autoHint: When no compatible native endpoint exists, try another compatible upstream protocol.
protocolPolicy.sameHint: Skip this channel unless a matching upstream protocol exists. Retries follow the same policy.
protocolPolicy.required: Select at least one allowed client protocol.
protocolPolicy.summarySame: These client protocols use only matching upstream protocols. Unselected protocols cannot use this channel.
protocolPolicy.summaryAuto: Conversion is allowed only to configured endpoints that preserve the request requirements.
protocolPolicy.transportHint: Responses HTTP and WebSocket count as one protocol. Request body passthrough is separate; matching protocols do not imply byte-for-byte forwarding.
protocolRoutes.title: Protocol routes
protocolRoutes.description: Inspect models and candidate channels for each client protocol.
protocolRoutes.evidenceHint: Only matching ingress, model and upstream successes from the last 7 days after the model and channel were last edited. This is not live health or proof of all tool capabilities.
protocolRoutes.empty: No enabled public chat models found.
protocolRoutes.scopeHint: Service-wide configuration view of public model IDs. API key, project permissions, rate limits, tools and continuation state can further narrow candidates. Conditional channels are counted separately.
protocolRoutes.branchHint: The same model may have multiple protocol branches, selected by association order and request conditions. Channel counts are deduplicated and do not guarantee the same outbound protocol for every request.
